title: Decision matching in pack is calibrated on real decisions
goal: Once the kb holds real decisions, the pack's decision match (60% of the question's informative words plus every name, at most 3 lines and a third of the budget) and kbdecide sweep's relink cut (difflib 0.5) are measured over them and lookup_eval rows, and each threshold is kept or changed on that evidence.

trigger.when: kb facts cite [DECISION ...] and lookup_eval.csv holds decision questions

notes: Waits until kb facts cite decisions and lookup_eval has decision questions: kb/_self/_decisions.csv holds 13 active rows (2026-10-05), all backlog-process decisions; no kb fact cites [DECISION ...] and lookup_eval has no decision question, so neither threshold (kbfacts DECISION_ANSWER_SHARE 0.6, kbdecide MIN_SIMILAR 0.5) has data to calibrate on.
